buildCommand: node -e '(async()=>{const url="https://seoul-place-docent-mcp.vercel.app/mcp";for(const [method,params,id] of [["initialize",{protocolVersion:"2025-11-25",capabilities:{},clientInfo:{name:"registration-diagnostic",version:"1"}},1],["notifications/initialized",{},null],["tools/list",{},2]]){try{const r=await fetch(url,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json",...(method==="initialize"?{}:{"MCP-Protocol-Version":"2025-11-25"})},body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:"2.0",method,params,...(id===null?{}:{id})}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});const raw=await r.text();const x=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{};console.log("MCP_PROBE",method,r.status,x.result?.protocolVersion??x.result?.tools?.map(t=>[t.name,t.inputSchema?.type])??x.error??null)}catch(e){console.log("MCP_PROBE",method,String(e))}}})();' && pnpm run build:vercel
